messages:
sarah-customer: Hey team — since token rotation yesterday our calls to /v1/generate with json_mode=structured started returning invalid JSON for some users. Fields flip types: numeric ids become quoted, booleans null, enums uppercased. Also saw 502s and customer retries spiking our bill. Example req id req-9a2b3c. Any idea?

maria-support: Sorry about that — can you paste a minimal repro curl and the raw response body? Which model/version and deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

sarah-customer: repro below (we're on Private behind API GW, model: redwood-compat-alpha:2026-03-10, dedicated pool). Curl:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "model":"redwood-compat-alpha:2026-03-10",
  "json_mode":"structured",
  "json_schema": {"id":"integer","active":"boolean","status":"enum[active,inactive]"},
  "prompt":"Return JSON with id, active, status"
}'
```

raw response (cropped):
```json
{"id":"12345","active":null,"status":"ACTIVE"}
```

This causes our parser to throw and we retry, costing tokens.

kevin-eng: Thanks — that payload makes sense. Two quick questions: did you have prefix caching enabled on the private runtime? Also any autoscale events around 2026-03-12 17:40 UTC?

sarah-customer: yes prefix cache=true on dedicated pool. Autoscale did a cold add of 2 nodes around that time.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: infra/private-runtime v1.14.2 -> v1.15.0 by ops at 1768000010

jordan-ml: possible hypothesis: after the deploy we started serving a different model variant (quantized) with a slightly different tokenizer/decoder profile that sometimes emits tokens that lead the structured parser to mis-coerce enums/booleans. Prefix/KV cache + model variant mismatch can cause truncated KV leading to shifted token alignments and parse failures.

maria-support: Thanks @jordan-ml — can you reproduce locally with the exact model and prefix-cache enabled? @sarah-customer can you also share two failing request ids and timestamps so we can pull runtime logs?

sarah-customer: sure — failing ids: req-9a2b3c (2026-03-12T17:41:07Z), req-9a2b9f (2026-03-12T17:42:33Z). Full raw for req-9a2b3c:

```json
{"id":"12345","active":null,"status":"ACTIVE","_raw_tokens":"▁{ ▁\" id \" : ▁\"12345\" , ▁\" active \" : ▁null , ▁\" status \" : ▁\"ACTIVE\" ▁ }"}
```

kevin-eng: got it. That _raw_tokens looks like decoder emitted quotes around number token. Could be generated as token sequence that the JSON assembler mis-handled. I'll pull kernel logs and check quantization mapping. Also will search for similar errors across tenants.

maria-support: For an immediate customer-facing workaround — you can set `json_mode=relaxed` or run a lightweight post-processor that coerces numeric strings to numbers and maps null->false for your boolean fields to avoid retries. We'll open a support ticket and issue billing credits for retry cost. Ticket: SUP-2026-847.

jordan-ml: Tech workaround: try forcing model variant pinning to non-quantized build: `model: redwood-compat-alpha:2026-03-10+fp16` and disable prefix cache for that client to see if it resolves.

sarah-customer: will try pinning and post results.

maria-support: Escalating to eng-ml for investigation of prefix-cache + model variant interplay. Assigned to kevin-eng and jordan-ml. We'll update SUP-2026-847 once we have root cause and ETA. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

kevin-eng: I'll add a debug endpoint to capture raw token streams for failing requests and correlate with KV offsets.

sarah-customer: thanks, much appreciated.
